words.d: a row of metal rings joined together
the opening in a wall you enter or leave through
something that gives you a way to get in
a barrier that goes around an area
a small metal device that turns in a lock
to close something with a key
to move something so an opening is blocked
a fastener on a door that keeps it closed
to make something visible for everyone to see
to move a lid so an opening is closed
to close a door with a key
an opening with glass in the wall of a building

videos.desc: Two men close a tall iron gate and wrap a heavy metal chain around its bars several times, pulling it tight to lock the gate shut, then smile and shake hands.

In a cartoon canal scene at night, a hand pushes a brass key into the keyhole of a wooden houseboat door and turns it. The woman in a red coat tests the handle, says all is safe, and walks away along the dock.

A camera fixed under a helicopter looks back at its wide open side door. Three skydivers sit inside the cabin with their backs to the camera, framed by the doorway, with blue sky and a coastline visible through the opening. One by one they swing out through the open door onto the landing skid, stand on it barefoot holding the frame, and then push off. They drop away in a spread position over a coastal town with a winding river and a long white beach. The helicopter climbs and shrinks to a small shape in the empty blue sky.

A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

A woman in a denim cap with a plait, an orange fleece and a backpack holds the camera at arm's length on a canyon viewpoint at sunrise. Behind her a wooden post-and-rail fence runs along the rim, closing off the drop. She turns from the camera to the canyon, her mouth open, and swings her free arm out towards the orange-lit rock walls; then she claps her hand over her mouth and keeps staring out over the fence at the canyon.

A woman in a denim jacket stands in a hallway looking around with a frustrated frown. She crouches at an open kitchen drawer and rakes through hair ties, tape rolls, markers and packets. She moves into a walk-in wardrobe and pushes along the rail of hanging clothes, then tips a wicker laundry basket full of clothes upside down onto a chest of drawers. Finally she sits on the floor by a pile of clothes and holds a small metal key up to the camera with her mouth open in triumph.

A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.

A woman in a bright yellow raincoat stands on the step of a blue front door with a brass knocker, digging anxiously through her beige tote bag. She finds a bunch of keys and holds them up in front of her face, grinning with relief. A close shot shows her sliding one key into the round metal lock set in the blue door and turning it. She pushes the door open and steps into the hallway.

A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.

A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.

A large crowd in summer clothes is packed in front of two huge studded wooden gates set in a grey stone archway, with pink and white bunting strung above them. Two members of staff push the gates apart from the inside and a bright strip of the park appears between them. As the gates swing fully open a painted carousel comes into view beyond the archway. The crowd streams forward through the entrance and out into the fairground, a young woman in a red dress laughing and running ahead of them towards the carousel.

In a bedroom papered with travel posters, a young woman kneels over a hard-shell suitcase lying open on the bed. She folds T-shirts and stacks them in until the case is heaped over the rim, then grabs the lid and swings it down. It will not close, so she climbs on top, sits on the lid with her whole weight and presses it down with both hands, pulling faces the whole time.

A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.

The point of view of a courier in a narrow alley where every wall, step and door is painted bright blue. One hand in a rust-coloured sleeve holds out a brown paper parcel tied with string while the other knocks on a tall blue studded door. A smiling young woman in a blue shirt and white trousers leans out of the doorway, takes the parcel and holds it to her chest. A rooster walks across the lane by her feet, pots of red geraniums hang on the walls, and a blue bench and an iron lantern line the lane.

In a zoo yard at dusk, wet with rain and scattered with straw, a young man in a navy fleece, work trousers and green wellington boots stands at a heavy green wooden door in a stone wall and turns a big key in the lock under a glowing lamp. Then he steps back from the door and turns, surprised, towards a crowd of king penguins standing behind him. One king penguin stands right next to the door looking up, a few lie on their bellies, and a keeper with a wheelbarrow waits in the mist.

The front door of a house on a grey autumn day. The letterbox is stuffed with newspapers, and a pile of newspapers and bottles of milk sit unopened on the doorstep, showing that nobody is at home. A golden retriever in an orange high-visibility vest sits on the doormat with a cardboard parcel hanging from its neck, scratches at the door with one paw, looks up at the letterbox and then lies down to wait. From the window next door a smiling young woman leans out and sips from a mug.
